g.text: Fig. 22. Selective prediction on TRAIN (nested CV by dependency cluster, seeds 11/22/33; TEST not used). Abstention thresholds are r-quantiles of
scores learnt on the outer training fold only (local error = mean |inner out-of-fold Ridge residual| of the 15 nearest training contrasts; AD = mean
distance to the 5 nearest; disagreement = |Ridge − training mean|; random = control). (a, d) RMSE of Ridge on the retained contrasts and of the mean
on the same contrasts. (b, e) Difference Ridge − mean on the retained contrasts, band = 95 % cluster-bootstrap CI (local error), numbers = retained
studies. (c, f) Coverage of the Ridge 95 % interval (constant half-width ≈ 0.86 yield / 0.83 biomass, set on inner OOF residuals). [V5 (2026-11-20)]
